1.w: A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving devotion of YHWH forever. To generation and generation I will make known Your faithfulness with my mouth.

2.w: For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; the heavens—You establish Your faithfulness in them.”

3.w: “I have cut a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:

4.w: ‘Even to forever I will establish Your seed, and build up for generation and generation your throne.’” Selah

5.w: and the heavens will praise Your wonders, O YHWH, [and] Your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

6.w: For who in the heavens can be compared to YHWH, likened to YHWH among the sons of the mighty?

7.w: God is to be feared greatly in the council of the holy ones, and to be revered by all those surrounding Him.

8.w: O YHWH, God of Hosts, who [is] like You, O mighty YAH? And Your faithfulness surrounds You!

9.w: You rule over the pride of the sea; its waves mount up, [and] You still them.

10.w: You crushed Rahab as one slain; with the arm of Your strength, You scattered Your enemies.

11.w: Unto You [are] the heavens; the earth also [is] unto You; the world and its fullness—You have founded them.

12.w: The north and the south, You have created them; Tabor and Hermon ring out praise in Your name.

13.w: Unto You [is] an arm with might; strong [is] Your hand; high [is] Your right hand.

14.w: Righteousness and justice [are] the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before Your face.

15.w: Blessed [are] the people knowing the joyful sound; O YHWH, in the light of Your face they walk.

16.w: In Your name they rejoice all the day, and in Your righteousness they are lifted high.

17.w: For You [are] the splendor of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is raised high.

18.w: Indeed, unto YHWH [is] our shield, and our king unto the Holy One of Israel.

19.w: Once You spoke in a vision to Your holy ones, and said: “I have given help to a mighty one; I have exalted one chosen from the people.

20.w: I have found David My servant; with the oil of My holiness I anointed him,

21.w: with whom My hand is established—My arm also will strengthen him.

22.w: The enemy will not exact tribute from him, and a son of wickedness shall not afflict him.

23.w: And I will crush his foes before his face, and those hating him I will strike.

24.w: And My faithfulness and My loving devotion [are] with him, and in My name his horn will be exalted.

25.w: And I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand over the rivers.

26.w: He will call to Me, ‘You [are] My Father, my God, and the Rock of my salvation.’

27.w: I also appoint him firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

28.w: Forever I will keep for him My loving devotion, and My covenant will stand fast for him.

29.w: And I will establish His seed forever, and his throne like the days of the heavens.

30.w: If his sons should abandon My instruction, and do not walk in My ordinances,

31.w: if they violate My statutes, and do not keep My commandments,

32.w: then I will attend [to] their transgression with the rod, and [to] their iniquity with stripes.

33.w: And I will not break off My loving devotion from him, and I will not be false in My faithfulness.

34.w: I will not violate My covenant, and a declaration of My lips I will not change.

35.w: Once I have sworn by My holiness—I will not lie to David—

36.w: His seed shall be forever, and his throne like the sun before Me.

37.w: Like the moon It will be established forever, even [as] the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah

38.w: and You have cast away and rejected; You have been enraged with Your anointed.

39.w: You have renounced the covenant of Your servant; You have defiled his diadem on the ground.

40.w: You have broken down all his walls; You have set his strongholds [to] ruin.

41.w: All passing by the way plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.

42.w: You have raised high the right hand of his adversaries; all of his enemies You have made glad.

43.w: Also You have turned back the sharpness of his sword, and You have not made it stand in the battle.

44.w: You have made his brightness cease, and You have cast down his throne to the ground.

45.w: You have shortened the days of his youth; You have covered over him [with] shame. Selah

46.w: until when, O YHWH? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your rage keep burning like fire?

47.w: Remember me—how [short] a lifetime; for what emptiness You created all the sons of men!

48.w: What man can live and not see death? Can he deliver his soul from the hand of Sheol? Selah

49.w: where [is] Your loving devotion [is] Your Of old, O Lord, which You swore of David in Your faithfulness?

50.w: Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants—I bear in my bosom from all the many peoples,

51.w: with which Your enemies have taunted, O YHWH, with which they have reproached the footsteps of Your anointed one.

52.w: Blessed [be] YHWH forever! Amen and Amen.
